mapper.sql: forecast_id, plan_id, forecast_no, forecast_type, forecast_method, forecast_date, forecast_amount, actual_amount, forecast_accuracy, confidence_interval, forecast_period, data_source, model_parameters, forecast_notes, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, description, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_forecast WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY forecast_date DESC
SELECT FROM fund_forecast WHERE forecast_type = #{forecastType} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY forecast_date DESC
SELECT FROM fund_forecast WHERE forecast_method = #{forecastMethod} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY forecast_date DESC
SELECT FROM fund_forecast WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND forecast_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY forecast_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_forecast WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT forecast_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_forecast WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY forecast_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT forecast_method as method, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_forecast WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY forecast_method ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT forecast_method, COUNT(*) as forecastCount, COALESCE(AVG(forecast_accuracy), 0) as avgAccuracy, COALESCE(MIN(forecast_accuracy), 0) as minAccuracy, COALESCE(MAX(forecast_accuracy), 0) as maxAccuracy, COUNT(CASE WHEN forecast_accuracy >= 90 THEN 1 END) as excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN forecast_accuracy >= 80 AND forecast_accuracy < 90 THEN 1 END) as goodCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN forecast_accuracy < 80 THEN 1 END) as poorCount FROM fund_forecast WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND actual_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY forecast_method ORDER BY avgAccuracy DESC
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(forecast_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM fund_forecast WHERE forecast_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
